images.cradle_starlight: An empty handmade wooden cradle with a soft blanket under a window full of stars, gentle silver light, wondrous and calm.
images.prayer_niche_light: A quiet stone prayer niche with a small oil lamp and a folded prayer cloth, soft golden light pouring in, pure and peaceful, nobody present.
images.quiet_place_east: A secluded peaceful spot east of a small town at sunrise, a low stone wall and a curtain of fabric gently moving in the breeze, nobody present.
images.palm_tree_stream: A single tall date palm tree in a quiet desert valley with a small fresh stream bubbling at its foot, ripe dates hanging, soft evening light, nobody present.
images.dates_falling: Fresh ripe golden-brown dates gently falling from a palm tree onto soft sand next to a little stream, warm light, nobody present.
images.clay_bird_flying: A small bird made of soft brown clay coming to life and flying up from a wooden table into a bright sky, magical sparkles, nobody present.
images.healing_light_village: A small ancient village at sunrise with gentle golden light shining over the houses, hopeful and healing atmosphere, nobody present.
images.table_from_sky: A beautiful table set with bread, fish and fruits descending gently from glowing clouds in a golden sky, wondrous and festive, no people.
images.lifted_light_sky: Soft beams of light rising upward from quiet hills into gentle glowing clouds at dusk, peaceful, protective and wondrous, no figures, no crosses.
